attribution: 2026年度東京大学シビックテックデザイン学講座Team 1
method: Each response is the average of answered question points. Each question point is the barycentric weighted mean of its three unchanged reference-cat X/Y coordinates. All-skipped uses (5,5). No empirical scale validation is claimed.
geography: Self-selected activity area, quantized to 0.01-degree cells; no GPS or exact click coordinates retained. GeoJSON uses [longitude,latitude] cell centers or null geometry.
sampling: Voluntary, self-selected responses; duplicates and selection bias are possible. Do not estimate resident population or causal efficacy.
api: See publicAPI link on the map page or openDataUrl in ../config.js; append ?api=ieneko2&mode=aggregate.

fields.data_kind: responses, sample, or imported. Sample data never represent actual participants.
fields.month: Month in Asia/Tokyo, YYYY-MM. No individual response time is published.
fields.event: Optional event identifier, supplied by the participant.
fields.region: Optional self-reported municipality name. No street address.
fields.lat: Optional latitude of a 0.01-degree cell center, WGS84. Not the original click position.
fields.lon: Optional longitude of the same cell center, WGS84.
fields.n: Number of responses in this public group, at least 5. Not unique people.
fields.mean_x: Mean authored design X coordinate, 0..10; not a validated scale.
fields.mean_y: Mean authored design Y coordinate, 0..10; not a geographic latitude.
fields.matatabi_n: Responses selecting playful tools; multiple selections allowed.
fields.churu_n: Responses selecting small rewards or enjoyable invitations.
fields.tower_n: Responses selecting enabling environments, places, time or roles.
fields.support_n: Responses selecting at least one support option. Denominator for support percentages.
fields.license: CC-BY-4.0 for consented response aggregates only.
fields.attribution: Creator attribution. Source reference cats and cited works have separate terms.
fields.q1_a: Mean share for answer A of question 1, 0..1; empty when q1_n is 0.
fields.q1_b: Mean share for answer B of question 1, 0..1; empty when q1_n is 0.
fields.q1_c: Mean share for answer C of question 1, 0..1; empty when q1_n is 0.
fields.q1_n: Non-skipped responses to question 1 within this group.
